fire_when: A proof factors costs along a globally selected minimizing path solely because input edges are iid.
silent_when: The proof computes a covariance under an explicitly constructed independent coordinate-refresh coupling.
text: Iid input edges need not stay independent after path selection. The square example gives covariance -5/121 after conditioning. Prove the actual factorization or use a covariance/martingale identity.

fire_when: A rate-one refresh variance identity integrates the shared-coordinate kernel with no retained-coordinate factor.
silent_when: The identity includes exp(-t), or uses p=1-exp(-t) with the factor absorbed into dp.
text: Check refresh normalization. A one-edge Uniform[1,2] example requires integral exp(-t)/12=1/12; omitting retention makes it infinite. An exact identity still needs the quantitative crossover estimate.
evidence: w362/PEER_REVIEWS.jsonl:w362-R003; INDEPENDENT_KERNEL_AUDIT.md; w361 ATTEMPT.md one-edge control

fire_when: A proof bounds the full unweighted refresh kernel by an integrable all-time decay envelope without treating its first-order floor.
silent_when: The proof uses the weighted energy or subtracts the first-order floor before bounding the remainder.
text: An unweighted refresh kernel can retain a first-order floor. The square gives L=1/4. Separate L from the decaying remainder; an integrable envelope on the full kernel is impossible if L>0.
evidence: w362/FLOOR_RECEIPT.json and PEER_REVIEWS.jsonl:w362-R007; exact spectral masses

fire_when: A proof uses isotropy or zero covariance to treat conditional laws as fixed or to bound every conditional Poincare constant uniformly.
silent_when: A product law has an explicitly fixed conditional measure, or the proof controls derivative-of-law and conditional constants quantitatively.
text: Zero covariance does not freeze conditional laws. The isotropic log-concave cone has unbounded conditional Poincare constants and d E[z²|x]/dx unequal to E[partial_x z²|x]. Check the fibre and its changing support.
